title: Migration slice: vendor DLP import, Evaluate All Rules wizard, pack importer

checks.what: DOCTYPE/ENTITY refused in UTF-8, UTF-16 LE/BE (BOM or declaration), Latin-1 declared, inside zips
JSON and XML nested past 64 levels refused in words
member count cap, password-protected, damaged CRC, expansion cap
upload refused from its length before decoding
every imported/pack regex parsed, lookaround and ReDoS shapes refused before ZIA
rule CSV export neutralises = + - @ cells; vendor data is never re-exported as CSV
${ and %{ escaped in reviewed text, refused in engine expressions; HCL strings escaped
decisions, rules, exceptions, pack files of the wrong type answered in words
channel words, Symantec facets, Forcepoint/Skyhigh classifiers, rule labels, efficacy arithmetic
server write gates on enable/delete-all/post (shared route tests) and the module's own writes_enabled gate
every dry run issues only GETs, with writes enabled
proposed order sent as order n; ties keep admin order; fetched rules in ZIA order
Step 2 backup restores a reorder; delete-all backup re-creates the policy; failed enable restores the object
rule ids reach request paths only as whole numbers
fetched export and CLI outputs 0600 from creation
fetcher: HTTPS only, no redirects, plain header names, size-capped
no token or credential in results, errors or files (fetch token only in the request header)
duplicate detection linear
rule labels and name-derived ids unchanged from earlier versions; built-in packs pass all new checks
migrate/reorder 500, migrate/export empty file, migrate/post mode before sign-in (outside owned files)
docs/SECURITY_TESTING.md is regenerated from test docstrings and is stale after the new mapped tests; the integrator runs python tools/security_test_matrix.py (file and tool are not editable here)

findings.title: Evaluate All enable step could PUT a one-field body to /zia/advancedSettings, resetting every other advanced setting
findings.fix: Removed the minimal-body PUT; only GET-modify-PUT of the whole object remains

findings.title: Rule id from an uploaded rule list was written into the PUT/DELETE request path (path steering to other ZIA endpoints)
findings.fix: A rule id reaches the path only as a positive whole number; anything else is reported and not sent

findings.title: Imported vendor regexes reached ZIA unvalidated (ReDoS shapes, invalid syntax, lookaround)
findings.fix: compile_export runs every dictionary through dictionary_limit_problems, which now parses each pattern and refuses nested unbounded repeats

findings.title: Pack dictionary patterns were never parsed or checked for catastrophic backtracking
findings.fix: New dlp_importer.pattern_problems (parse + nested-repeat check, PCRE-only escapes tolerated); all 270 shipped patterns pass

findings.title: Duplicate-id detection counted each id with list.count (quadratic): one duplicate in a large export pinned the CPU
findings.fix: collections.Counter in _finish and in the duplicate-decision check

findings.title: An unknown post mode was treated as update and wrote to the tenant
findings.fix: post_new_rule_order refuses any mode but auto/create/update before planning or writing

findings.title: Fetched rules kept the API's list order, so a backup posted back (undo) could restore a different order
findings.fix: fetch_current_rules returns rules sorted by ZIA order (stable; unnumbered last), non-objects dropped

findings.title: Delete-all returned no copy of the deleted rules, so the destructive step had no undo
findings.fix: The real run returns `backup` (every deleted rule, in order) that Step 5 create re-posts

findings.title: A failed enable left the setting at the last enum word tried
findings.fix: When a value was accepted but none verified, the object is PUT back exactly as read

findings.title: Enable wrote guessed keys onto settings objects and enum words into boolean fields
findings.fix: Only fields the endpoint carries are written, booleans only ever get True; documented /webDlpGlobalOptions tried first (SDK 1.11.3)

findings.title: Rules with the same action and scope were re-sorted by name, changing same-action precedence
findings.fix: Ties keep their current order (stable sort without a name key)

findings.title: duplicate_names in the analysis was always 0
findings.fix: Counted from a set of names seen more than once

findings.title: Analysis, plan and optimiser crashed (500) on uploaded rules or exceptions of the wrong type
findings.fix: Fields read through _word/_text/_count; exceptions type-checked; position parsed safely

findings.title: skip_rule_ids kept the unconverted original (dropping its audit-only conversion) and stamped the caller's dicts
findings.fix: Skipped rules come from the working copies; the plan copies its input

findings.title: Per-rule mode field read with bool(): BY_RULE_ORDER read as Evaluate All
findings.fix: Read with _is_truthy like every other mode field

findings.title: Heuristic first-match / rule-order keys were read with Evaluate-All polarity
findings.fix: A boolean on such a key is inverted

findings.title: Decisions whose lists were not lists of objects raised AttributeError (500)
findings.fix: Structure checked up front; plain ValueError -> 400

findings.title: Phrase/pattern limits counted characters, and names/engine counts ZIA refuses compiled as ready
findings.fix: Shared byte-based limits, name_problems and engine_limit_problems in compile

findings.title: Control characters in rule names, tenant names and custom headers reached HCL/Terraform strings
findings.fix: Refused with a question

findings.title: Channel words matched as substrings (Capital -> API, fingerprint -> printer, Atlanta -> LAN)
findings.fix: Whole-word matching with plural/-ed/-ing forms

findings.title: Id-less policies whose names slug alike made the whole export refused as duplicates
findings.fix: Name-derived ids disambiguated (-2, -3); first keeps its earlier id; real duplicate ids still refused

findings.title: Uploads were decoded before the size check; non-text content was stringified
findings.fix: Length-based refusal before decoding; non-text refused

findings.title: Fetched export and CLI outputs were created with default permissions (chmod after write)
findings.fix: safe_files.private_open / write_private_atomic (0600 from the first byte)

findings.title: CLI printed a traceback for a too-deep decisions file
findings.fix: RecursionError answered in words, exit 1

findings.title: One malformed pack file broke pack discovery (every page listing packs) and the pack detail page
findings.fix: _load_json validates list-of-objects; broken packs listed with `error`

findings.title: Engine counts of thousands of digits raised ValueError (int digit limit)
findings.fix: Length compared before int()

findings.title: build_dict_kwargs crashed on a text proximity, a pattern without action, a non-numeric template id
findings.fix: Each answered as a refusal or converted

findings.title: A pack web rule with an unrecognised action word was created with that action instead of monitor-only
findings.fix: Every pack web rule is created DISABLED with ALLOW

findings.title: A decisions file with a UTF-8 byte-order mark was refused as invalid JSON
findings.fix: Read through the BOM-aware text reader

findings.title: Activation wait used the real clock and time.sleep (not injectable)
findings.fix: Bounded by poll count with the module's _sleep

findings.title: POST /api/migrate/reorder answers 500 for an order token that is an object or list (outside owned files)
findings.fix: Proposed: skip non-scalar tokens into missing_tokens; compare names as text
findings.test: (server route not owned; verified by probe)

findings.title: POST /api/migrate/export?format=<other> answers 200 with an empty text/csv file (outside owned files)
findings.fix: Proposed: 400 unless format is json or csv
findings.test: (server route not owned; verified by probe)
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/dlp_api_server.py
+++ b/dlp_api_server.py
@@ -7454,6 +7454,8 @@
         from rule_migrator import generate_migration_plan, export_rules
     except Exception as e:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"rule_migrator not available: {e}")
+    if format not in ("json", "csv"):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format must be json or csv")
     data = await _json_object(request)
     rules = _rule_rows(data, "No rules provided in request body.")
     plan = generate_migration_plan(rules)

findings.title: POST /api/migrate/post validates mode only after sign-in (module now refuses without writing; route should 400 first)
findings.fix: Proposed: refuse an unknown mode in the route before any gate or sign-in
findings.proposed_patch:
--- a/dlp_api_server.py
+++ b/dlp_api_server.py
@@ -7355,6 +7355,9 @@
         raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"rule_migrator not available: {e}")
     if not req.proposed_rules:
         raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="No proposed_rules provided.")
+    from rule_migrator import POST_MODES
+    if req.mode not in POST_MODES:   # refused before any gate or sign-in, never read as "update"
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"mode must be one of {', '.join(POST_MODES)}")
     if not req.dry_run:
         _require_tenant_write(req, confirmed=req.confirm, what="Posting rules to the tenant")
     _require_in_scope(req, "dlp", MIGRATE_WHAT, "web_dlp")   # user rule 1: nothing read out of scope
